subject: Hosted API pricing for enterprise pilot - discount escalation
messages:
From: Emma Rhodes <emma@nexahealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-08-28T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API pricing for enterprise pilot

Hi Sean,

Thanks for the quick demo yesterday — the Redwood hosted API looks like a good fit for our ingestion pipelines. We ran initial traffic estimates through our infra team and expect ~5-7B generated tokens / month across our pilot cohorts.

Budget is tight for Q4. To make the economics work we need to target a 30–40% reduction from the list volume rate you showed in the demo. Can you share a firm price for a 12-month pilot at that discount range? Also attaching our usage forecast for context.

If the numbers line up we can move to an SOW quickly.

Cheers,
Emma Rhodes
Head of Platform, NexaHealth
emma@nexahealth.com

Attachment: NEXA_forecast_final.xlsx

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.inference>
To: Emma Rhodes <emma@nexahealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-08-28T13:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing for enterprise pilot

Emma — really appreciate the detail and the forecast. Great to see the volume upside. I ran the numbers against our standard hosted API tiers and attached a conservative quote and an updated usage template (see attachment).

High level: with a 12-month committed minimum and a quarterly usage review we can offer differentiated volume pricing. That said, anything over a 20% unit-rate concession requires executive review and approval given margin impact. If you confirm the 12-month commit and a target 6B token/month baseline, I can escalate an approval request to our deal desk / sales leadership.

I've attached: NEXA_forecast_final.xlsx (you sent), plus my internal forecast sheet: Nexa_Q3_usage_v2.xlsx and a draft SOW. If you can confirm the commit (months + baseline) I will submit an internal escalation with recommended concession (you asked 35%).

Next steps: confirm baseline + legal contact for SOW, and I will loop in Ben and Marissa for executive consideration.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.inference

Attachments: Nexa_Q3_usage_v2.xlsx, SOW_draft_Nexa.pdf

From: Emma Rhodes <emma@nexahealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-08-29T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing for enterprise pilot

Sean — thanks. Confirming: 12-month pilot, committed baseline 6,000,000,000 generated tokens / month with a 30% annual growth buffer. Procurement will need line-item pricing for usage overages and a billing cadence (monthly invoicing preferred).

To close the ROI case internally we need ~35% off the list hosted unit rate. If we can get that with a standard SOW and a mutual NDA for customer data handling we can sign and start migration in early October.

Contracts contact: contracts@nexahealth.com

-Emma

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.inference>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-08-29T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: NexaHealth hosted API — exec approval request (35% ask)

Ben / Marissa — forwarding Nexa thread. Prospecting turned fast: NexaHealth is ready to commit to a 12-month pilot at ~6B gen tokens/month but requires ~35% off list hosted token rates to reach their ROI thresholds. They prefer monthly billing and want a standard SOW + NDA.

Why I recommend approving some concession:
- Strategic vertical buyer (healthcare) with strong reference potential and multi-region expansion plans.
- Projected steady-state run-rate would be ~72B tokens/year at pilot baseline.
- They asked for a 12-month commit; willing to include a minimum monthly baseline and a migration credit if needed.

Risks: ~35% would materially cut unit margin for hosted API — we should require a 12-month revenue commitment, payment terms (net-30), and a quarterly business review. Could also offer a 30% concession as an alternative.

Attachments: NEXA_forecast_final.xlsx, Nexa_Q3_usage_v2.xlsx, SOW_draft_Nexa.pdf

Request: need executive signoff on concession >20%. Recommended ask: authorize up to 35% with the following guardrails: 12-month minimum, minimum committed token baseline, migration credit capped at $50k, and marketing/reference agreement.

Thanks — will stand by for decision.

—Sean

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-08-30T16:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: NexaHealth hosted API — exec approval request (35% ask)

Team — reviewed forecast and margin impact. NexaHealth looks strategically attractive and the volume is real, but 35% is outside the normal guardrails for hosted API without a larger commercial package. I am willing to authorize a 30% concession (i.e., 30% off list hosted token pricing) under the following conditions:

1) Signed 12-month committed baseline at 6B gen tokens/month (no swap to month-to-month).
2) Net-30 billing; Redwood to reserve right to pause concession for non-payment.
3) One-time migration credit capped at $50,000, paid as an initial invoice credit.
4) Customer agrees to be a reference (case study + brief quote) after first 90 days of production.

If legal needs to change SOW terms (data, SLA), loop in Legal and I will co-sign. If this sounds acceptable, Sean — please finalize SOW, capture procurement contact, and send an offer email with the concession and the stairs for overage pricing.

I will not approve 35% at this time; 30% is the limit I can sanction without CFO escalation. If Marketing/Enterprise wants a deeper discount we can present to CFO for final sign-off.

-Ben Carter
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.inference

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.inference>
To: Emma Rhodes <emma@nexahealth.com>, NexaHealth Procurement <contracts@nexahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-09-01T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API commercial terms — NexaHealth pilot (approved concession)

Emma — good news. Thanks for the patience while I looped in leadership. Redwood can offer a 30% discount off list hosted token rates for the 12-month committed pilot at the 6B gen tokens/month baseline. Key commercial points below:

- Effective discount: 30% off list unit price for committed baseline usage for 12 months.
- Commit: 6,000,000,000 gen tokens / month minimum; overage billed at published tiered rates.
- Billing: monthly invoicing, Net-30.
- One-time migration credit: $50,000 (applied to first invoice).
- Reference: Newport case-study style reference after 90 days of production, with mutual approval on public materials.
- SOW + NDA: attached SOW_draft_Nexa.pdf; please confirm procurement contact for signature (DocuSign link will be shared once SOW is finalized).

If you need the extra 5% (to reach 35%) we can escalate to CFO for review, but that will require a formal finance approval path and may require advance payment / larger commit. Ben has approved the 30% concession above.

Next steps: please confirm acceptance of these guardrails and procurement contact. I will route the SOW for signature and coordinate onboarding kickoff with Solutions Engineering.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.inference

Attachments: SOW_draft_Nexa.pdf
Related: https://hubspot.redwoodinference.com/deals/4521, DocuSign link to follow
